title: Implement bounded exact and compensated descriptive statistics in a provider-neutral package
commitMessage: feat: qualify independent finite and exact descriptive statistics

contribution.summary: Qualify a standalone .NET descriptive-statistics package using a controlled missing-contract RED and 19 independent GREEN tests: exact rational sums/means/extrema, compensated finite sums, centered population/sample variance, limits and nonfinite refusals. Register two lowercase projects with locked dependencies, corroborate using managed Math.NET 5.0.0, check the local NuGet package, and complete C01-T1 without closing C01 or M3-W02.
contribution.value: Give Math consumers reproducible, explicitly exact or approximate statistics without importing Decision or Math.NET implementation types. Report undefined singleton sample variance, separate sample/population denominators, numerical budgets and results with evidence rather than inferred scientific admission.
debtChanges: Statistics C01-T2 remains planned for explicit missing-value and weighted-input policies, further numerical scale limits and refusal semantics. A successful T1 is not completion of C01.
The provider-free statistics product depends only on dw.quantities; managed Math.NET 5.0.0 remains an independent test-only corroborator on the actually observed host.
Exact rational aggregates enforce finite cardinality and operand/intermediate bit budgets; floating Neumaier/centered variance does not become exact arithmetic or a universal conditioning guarantee.
Quantiles, correlation, distribution sampling, probability conventions and consumer interoperability are separate accepted later M3-W02 scopes.
No nutrition RecordTransformer, Decision VaR/CVaR, Aura host behavior, BrokerReady claim, or local implementation of the neutral dw.discovery contract is introduced.
The new .NET projects and lockfiles are part of a coherent executable source slice, not permanent root product code or empty unqualified scaffolding.
Published artifacts remain local NuGet candidates; no public package feed, native BLAS, paid CI or unexecuted platform is admitted.
contribution.nextAction: On RS044 success, qualify M3-W02-C01-T2's missing/weighted observations and boundary policies under the existing native plan. Watch neutral dw.discovery and Workflow #139 separately without duplicating them in Math.
